name: Perfected Zombie
description: A towering, muscular zombie with magically infused strength and skill.

abilities.name: Terrifying
abilities.description: When the Zombie makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

abilities.name: Fearsome Presence
abilities.description: PCs can’t spend Hope to use features against the Zombie.

abilities.name: Perfect Strike
abilities.description: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Zombie succeeds against are Vulnerable until their next rest.

abilities.name: Skilled Opportunist
abilities.description: When another adversary deals damage to a target within Very Close range of the Zombie, you can spend a Fear to add the Zombie’s standard attack damage to the damage roll.
